The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an 'I can do that' mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

Enterprise Accounts Sales Executive

We are hiring an Enterprise Accounts Sales Executive in the AECO field, you have extensive experience in Manufacturing, specifically with larger international businesses. You will have a key role in building strong, long-term customer partnerships and driving sustainable business growth across strategic enterprise accounts.

You will develop and execute account growth strategies, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and help customers achieve meaningful business outcomes through Autodesk solutions.
Success in this role comes from combining strategic thinking, relationship-building, commercial acumen, and collaborative problem-solving. As Enterprise Accounts Sales Executive you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders, bringing curiosity, empathy, and industry insight to every engagement. We support hybrid or remote working with no minimum office days, and you will report to the Director, Account Executive, Enterprise Sales.

5+ years of experience in enterprise, strategic, or complex B2B sales environments.
You have experience as a commission-based sales executive in AECO with emphasis on Manufacturing.
You are experienced in managing and growing enterprise customer relationships.
You have a proven ability to lead complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations and drive successful business outcomes.
You are experienced in managing pipelines, forecasting, and revenue planning.
You are a confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to engage executive stakeholders.
Fluency in English is required, fluency in Swedish, Danish or Norwegian would be beneficial

Experience working with Enterprise Business Agreements (EBAs) or large-scale commercial agreements.
Familiarity with SaaS, subscription, or consumption-based business models.
Experience collaborating with technical specialists, partner ecosystems, or cross-functional sales teams.
Knowledge of value-based selling, executive storytelling, and customer business reviews.
Experience coordinating teams and stakeholders through complex sales cycles.

Account Growth & Customer Success
Develop and execute growth strategies for enterprise accounts, including executive engagement and QBRs.
Build trusted customer relationships to understand business priorities and drive long-term value.
Identify opportunities to expand solution adoption, consumption, and business impact.
Strategic Deal Leadership
Lead complex EBA negotiations and expansion opportunities.
Navigate multi-stakeholder environments to align interests and drive successful outcomes.
Stakeholder Management
Expand relationships across business units and decision-makers.
Foster alignment and collaboration to support shared customer success.
Forecasting & Planning
Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting.
Leverage data and insights to inform strategic decisions and growth plans.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with technical sales, specialists, ATU teams, Deal Desk, and Customer Success to deliver customer value and seamless experiences.
Skills & Competencies
Communication & Leadership: Builds trust through effective communication and stakeholder engagement.
Strategic Thinking: Customer-focused, solution-oriented, and adept at solving complex challenges.
Business Acumen: Understands customer priorities and identifies growth opportunities through data-driven insights.
Relationship Building: Develops strong partnerships through collaboration, empathy, and influence.
Analytical Mindset: Uses data and critical thinking to drive decisions and improve outcomes.
Familiarity with CRM forecasting, pipeline analytics, and territory planning tools.

About the role Azumo is hiring a Sales Executive to originate new AI and ML services engagements with enterprise and mid-market companies across the US and Canada.

Over 80% of our new revenue now comes from AI-driven projects, and we need a seller who can identify the right opportunities, navigate technical buying committees, and close deals with real engineering scope. This is a hunter role. You will own pipeline generation, qualification, and close.

You will work alongside our engineering leadership on technical discovery and proposal development. You will sell into CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Heads of Data, and their teams.

What you'll do Originate new AI and ML services opportunities through targeted outbound, warm introductions, partner referrals, and inbound lead follow-up Build and manage a qualified pipeline across enterprise and mid-market accounts in the US and Canada Run technical discovery in partnership with our solutions and engineering leadership, converting business problems into defensible engagement scopes Shape proposals, SOWs, and commercial terms that reflect the real complexity of AI implementation work Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes involving technical evaluators, finance, legal, and executive sponsors Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene in HubSpot Represent Azumo 's engineering credibility in client conversations, not just our company story Requirements What we're looking for Solid experience selling technology services or custom software engineering engagements to US-based buyers.

A track record of originating new logo business, not only expanding existing accounts Working fluency in AI and ML sufficient to hold a substantive first call with a technical buyer.

You do not need to be an engineer, but you do need to speak credibly about model selection, LLM applications, data engineering, and production deployment concerns Experience carrying quota against six-figure and low-seven-figure deal sizes with multi-stakeholder decision processes Strong discovery skills.

You lead with questions, not pitches Disciplined about CRM hygiene, forecasting, and pipeline reviews Written and verbal communication that holds up in front of senior technical and executive audiences Based in the United States and authorized to work in the US Nice to have Prior experience selling nearshore or distributed engineering services Existing relationships with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, or Heads of Data at mid-market or enterprise companies Background in consulting, engineering, or another technical discipline before moving into sales Benefits Company benefits include: Paid Time Off Mentored Career Development U.S.

Holidays USD Remuneration Profit Sharing Maternity Coverage 100% Remote Compensation and location Remote within the United States. Compensation is commensurate with experience and includes base salary plus commission. About Azumo Azumo is a software engineering partner for the era of AI.

We have shipped production AI work for Meta, Discovery Channel, and dozens of other companies building real products on AI foundations. We are a services company, which means our credibility is measured by what we deliver, not by what we pitch.

This role exists because we are seeing more demand for AI implementation work than we currently have capacity to originate through our inbound only go-to-market strategy. Originally posted on Himalayas

We are a dynamic AI start-up based in the heart of Munich, setting the global standard for AI Coaching. While most AI companies are working on replacing human labor, we are unlocking the uniquely human strengths that drive lasting business outcomes for our enterprise clients.

Our in-house AI technology helps sales and service teams at global enterprises earn trust and win deals through realistic client simulations and deep behavioral feedback. Join our international team that is not just building a human-centric product, but redefining customer relationships.
About the role (Munich-based, German speaking): You are the tip of the spear for our enterprise motion in DACH. Paired one to one with a Senior Account Executive, you own the top of the funnel.

You research target accounts, reach the right people through cold calls, email and LinkedIn, and open conversations with senior commercial buyers in Sales Enablement and Commercial Excellence. This is a dedicated pod, not a shared pool. You feed a proven closer, learn enterprise selling from the inside, and grow into an Account Executive yourself.
Tasks
Generating qualified pipeline through proactive, multi-channel outbound: cold calls, personalized email sequences, and LinkedIn, into your target accounts
Researching accounts and buying centers, and identifying the right senior stakeholders in Sales Enablement, Commercial Excellence, and Service Ownership
Running crisp first conversations that qualify need and book meetings your paired Account Executive accepts
Working hand in hand with one senior Account Executive in a dedicated 1:1 pod: shared account plans, daily coordination, joint territory strategy
Keeping the CRM (HubSpot) clean and disciplined, so pipeline, activities, and handoffs stay reliable
Testing and improving messaging, sequences, and target lists together with marketing and your AE
Using Retorio's own platform to sharpen your outbound and discovery skills, and to know the product you sell from the inside

2 to 4 years of B2B SaaS outbound experience as an SDR or BDR, ideally into enterprise
A track record of consistently hitting or beating pipeline and meeting targets, with real numbers you can speak to
Strong on cold outbound: you can open a cold call, steer the conversation, and handle objections without a script
Business-fluent German (C1+) and English, the role is Munich-based and sells into the DACH market
Coachable, self-driven, and resilient: you seek feedback, act on it, and stay in the game through rejection
A clear ambition to grow into an Account Executive (see the path below)
Comfortable with modern outbound tooling: CRM (HubSpot), sales engagement, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and data enrichment
Bonus: experience selling into Pharma, Telco, FMCG, Insurance, Automotive, or Retail, or into sales enablement, coaching, or L&D-adjacent buyers

From the preset toggles, enable: Above-average compensation, Flexible working hours, and High-performance culture. As custom entries:
Uncapped commission with a competitive OTE: your earnings scale with the pipeline and the deals you help create
A clear path to Account Executive: this role is built as a launchpad, with a realistic move to AE in 18 to 24 months, and faster for a standout performer
A dedicated 1:1 partnership with a senior Account Executive who coaches you every week, not a shared BDR pool
Six-figure enterprise deals and reference clients across pharma, insurance, telecom, FMCG, retail and automotive
Direct access to the founders and real influence on how we sell
A product with a genuine scientific moat, built on the Warmth and Competence framework from TU Munich research, that you also use to get better yourself
A central Munich office with an international team
If you want to break into enterprise sales the right way, learning from a senior closer while building the pipeline that wins six-figure deals, send us your CV and a short note on the best cold call or outbound sequence you have run. You will hear back within a week, and the process is fast: intro call and deep dive with your future AE partner, a practical case that includes a live cold-call exercise and a conversation with a founder.

🚀 Sales Excecutive (m/w/d) bei NETSHAKE – Werde Teil des Gewinnerteams! Du liebst Vertrieb, bist ein Kommunikationstalent und willst Großes erreichen? Dann komm zu NETSHAKE – seit 26 Jahren im E-Commerce, offizieller Shopify Premier Partner . Diesen Status tragen nur wenige Agenturen in ganz Europa.

Er steht für Exzellenz, Performance und nachweisbare Ergebnisse auf höchstem Niveau. Wir verkaufen kein „Produkt“. Wir verkaufen skalierbare Systeme, die Unternehmen transformieren.

Als eine der führenden Shopify Premier Partnern im deutschsprachigen Raum arbeitest du mit ambitionierten Brands, die wachsen wollen – und mit Lösungen, die echten Impact liefern. Der E-Commerce-Markt wächst rasant. Und wir sind mittendrin – nicht am Rand.

Bei NETSHAKE bekommst du die Bühne, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, groß zu denken und deine Performance in echten Umsatz zu übersetzen. Kein Mittelmaß. Keine Limits. Nur Wachstum – für unsere Kunden und für dich.

Aufgaben 🔹 Opening & Kaltakquise – Du gehst aktiv in die Neukundenansprache, identifizierst Potenziale und eröffnest qualifizierte Opportunities.

Kein Warten auf Leads – du erzeugst Momentum. 🔹 Setter-Phase – Du qualifizierst Entscheider, analysierst Geschäftsmodelle und übergibst strukturierte, vorqualifizierte Cases an den Closer – oder entwickelst dich selbst dorthin. 🔹 Closer-Development – Schrittweise übernimmst du eigene Strategie- & Closing-Gespräche mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung. 🔹 Bedarfsanalyse auf C-Level – Du verstehst Geschäftsziele, erkennst Skalierungshebel und positionierst unsere Lösungen präzise. 🔹 Konsequente Follow-ups – Du bleibst dran.

Systematisch. Hartnäckig.

Abschlussorientiert. 🔹 Pipeline-Ownership – Saubere CRM-Dokumentation, KPI-Fokus und volle Transparenz über deine Zahlen. 🔹 Angebotsstrategie – Du erstellst individuelle, performance-orientierte Angebote mit klarem Mehrwert. 🔹 Prozess-Optimierung – Du denkst Sales unternehmerisch weiter und bringst Verbesserungsvorschläge aktiv ein.

Qualifikation ✔️ Unternehmermindset – Du denkst in Umsatz, Chancen und Lösungen.

Ownership statt Ausreden ist für dich selbstverständlich. ✔️ Hunter-Mentalität im Vertrieb – Du liebst Closing, beherrschst moderne Verkaufstechniken und willst gewinnen – nicht nur teilnehmen. ✔️ Volle Eigenverantwortung – Du organisierst dich selbst, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und lieferst Ergebnisse. ✔️ Performance-Drive – Herausforderungen triggern dich.

Du willst besser werden, schneller werden, größer denken. ✔️ Ziel- & Abschlussorientierung – KPIs sind für dich kein Druck, sondern Motivation.

Erfolge feierst du – aber erst nach dem Deal. ✔️ Wachstums-Mentalität – Du investierst in deine Weiterentwicklung und willst vom Setter zum Closer wachsen. ✔️ Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse – Verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits ✨ Attraktive Vergütung – Starkes Fixgehalt plus Bonusmodell. ✨ Sales Excellence – Exklusive Trainings mit Europas Top-Sales-Experten. Wir formen Performer, keine Verwalter. ✨ Shopify Academy – Tiefes Produkt- und Marktverständnis.

Dein Wissensvorsprung im E-Commerce-Game. ✨ Karriere mit Geschwindigkeit – Klare Wachstumsstruktur, schnelle Entwicklung, echte Aufstiegschancen für Hunter mit Drive. ✨ High-Performance-Umfeld – Systeme, KPIs und Prozesse, die dir den Rücken freihalten.

Fokus auf Closing, nicht auf Chaos. ✨ Maximale Flexibilität – Remote von überall oder Energie tanken in unserem stylischen Office in Bay Square, Business Bay, Dubai. ✨ Persönliche Entwicklung – jeden Tag – Ownership, Verantwortung, Wachstum. Komfortzone ist kein Bestandteil unseres Modells. ✨ Teamevents mit Energie – Gewinner feiern gemeinsam.

Wir suchen keine Bewerber. Wir suchen Hunter. Kein Limit im Kopf. Kein Limit im Einkommen. Bewirb dich jetzt, wenn du in einem professionellen Umfeld wachsen und Leistung bringen willst – komm ins Gewinnerteam! Originally posted on Himalayas

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology.

Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives.

With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world.

Are you a dynamic and driven Business Development Representative looking to grow your career in enterprise SaaS sales and marketing? Hawk is looking for a BDR in Munich or London to join our Marketing team, where you will be responsible for helping to generate revenue by building relationships and arranging meetings with our target accounts.

You will be adept at identifying prospect goals and pain-points and then combining email, social media and other channels to share content, insights and solutions that deliver real value and relevance.

Build value-led relationships with prospective mid-market and enterprise accounts via email and other channels
Research target accounts and contacts to understand their goals and pain-points, and identify opportunities for relevant engagement
Meet MQL and pipeline generation targets by setting up meetings between prospective customers and Hawk Sales representatives
Create and execute pre-event campaigns to drive awareness of Hawk event participation and schedule meetings
Attend industry events and conferences, as required
Execute timely and personalized post-event follow-up, converting event conversations and leads into qualified meetings
Leverage marketing campaigns and other content for optimized outreach and to generate demand for Hawk products and services
Write professional and appropriate email and other communication materials, knowing when and how to tailor emails to maximize engagement
Manage a variety of sales tools, combining intelligence from multiple sources to prioritize outreach based on intent and other factors
Build phenomenally productive relationships with your colleagues in Sales and Marketing
Be meticulous in maintaining records of contact and hold others to account on doing the same
Your Profile – You Will Bring
2+ years’ experience in a business development role at a B2B technology organization
A love for engaging with people and finding ways to connect challenges with solutions
A passion for the art/science of cold email writing
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; German would be an advantage
A drive for delivering results and working to targets
Positivity and resourcefulness
Resilience and tenacity
The ability to manage your time and prioritize tasks with a sense of urgency and focus
An interest in technology and AI
Familiarity with CRM systems
The ability to work as part of a cross-functional team, being based in Marketing and working with Sales on a daily basis
A hybrid working approach, spending two days per week in the London or Munich office
Knowledge of the financial services sector would be a significant advantage

Hunger: You want to make money and you are willing to work for it.
Experience: 1+ years in sales (SDR, BDR, or high-volume service).
Speed: You can build rapport instantly and manage a high-volume pipeline.
Coachability: You are ready to strip away bad habits and learn a world-class sales system.

Who are we?
HubSpot is a leading customer relationship management (CRM) platform for scaling companies. Tens of thousands of customers all over the world use our marketing, sales, and customer success software to grow their businesses. It's our mission to not just help them grow, but to help them grow better.
At HubSpot, we believe that our values live in our hearts, not our hallways. We want to build a company where people feel empowered to do their best work, wherever they are. Our ANZ office is located in Sydney’s CBD but this role offers flexibility to work remotely or in a hybrid arrangement. Applicants must be based in Australia's East Coast.

Do you want to join a high-producing and impactful sales and service team at HubSpot? The mission of the Associate Inbound Success Coach (customer service) team is to provide customers and prospects with the most immediate and high quality first interaction with HubSpot in order to drive great customers. This is an entry level role perfect for someone passionate about building a career in sales with progression opportunities into a Business Development Representative.
What will you do?
Navigate a high volume of product and sales related inquiries
Conduct consultative pre-qualification of prospects for HubSpot’s sales process via phone, live chat, and email

Über Statista
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. Durch die Bereitstellung verlässlicher und einfach nutzbarer Daten sowie verschiedener Datenanalyseprodukte und -dienstleistungen unterstützen wir Menschen weltweit, faktenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.
2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.
Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig – schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!
Deine Mission bei uns – Das Spielfeld
Stell dir vor, du arbeitest für das Unternehmen, das über 1 Million Statistiken zu praktisch jedem erdenklichen Thema bereithält. Von Fortune-500-CEOs bis hin zu Mittelstandsunternehmen – sie alle verlassen sich auf unsere Daten, um millionenschwere Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Und du? Du bist die erste Kontaktperson für potenzielle Kunden. Der Türöffner. Der Grundstein für erfolgreiche Geschäftsbeziehungen.
🎯 Outbound Excellence – Du machst den ersten Zug
Keine Kaltakquise nach Schema F. Du erhältst von unserem Leadmanagement Team deine Ideal Customer Profiles Accounts und Leads, die du direkt angehen kennst anhand einer Cadence in Salesforce

Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn – du nutzt alle Kanäle, um überzeugende Gespräche zu initiieren. Mal ist es die perfekt getimte E-Mail, mal die LinkedIn-Nachricht, die niemand ignorieren kann, mal der Anruf, der alles verändert.

Du erkennst echte Business-Potenziale und verwandelst Interesse in konkrete Opportunities. Du hörst zwischen den Zeilen, stellst die richtigen Fragen und weißt genau, wann ein Lead bereit für den nächsten Schritt ist.
🤝 Team & Collaboration – Gemeinsam stärker

s.h: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Business Development Managern
s.t: Ihr seid kein "wir gegen die" – ihr seid ein eingespieltes Team. Jede Woche im Stand-up, bei Account-Strategien, beim Feiern geschlossener Deals. Deine SQLs sind ihre Opportunities – gemeinsam bringt ihr Deals über die Ziellinie.
Du übergibst hochwertige Sales Qualified Leads an das Sales-Team – keine halbgaren Kontakte, sondern qualifizierte Opportunities, die das Team lieben wird.

Deine Insights aus dem Markt sind Gold wert. Was hörst du von den Kunden? Welche Einwände kommen immer wieder? Dein Feedback hilft uns allen, besser zu werden.
🚀 Strategische Projekte – Du gestaltest mit
Du optimierst gemeinsam mit dem Marketing-Team unsere Lead-Prozesse. Welche Kampagnen funktionieren? Wo verlieren wir Leads? Du bist mittendrin, nicht nur dabei.
Aktive Mitgestaltung von Marketing-Kampagnen und deren Erfolg. Du testest neue Ansätze, gibst Input aus der Front-Line und siehst direkt, wie deine Ideen Wirkung zeigen.

Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und setzt innovative Ansätze um. Neue Tools? Bessere Scripts? Kreative Outreach-Strategien? Wenn es funktioniert, gehört der Erfolg dir.
Du bist nicht nur Ausführender – du bist Mitgestalter.
Bist du unser nächster Hauptcharakter?
Du bist der Typ Mensch, der...
...ein "Nein" als "Noch nicht" versteht
50 Anrufe, 12 Gespräche, 3 Meetings, 1 SQL – und du feierst diese eine SQL wie einen Sieg. Weil es einer ist. Ablehnung? Lernchance. Voicemail? Nächster Versuch. Du bist mental stark, resilient und liebst die Jagd.
...Menschen lesen kann wie ein Buch
Du merkst sofort, ob dein Gegenüber unter Zeitdruck steht, wirklich interessiert ist oder nur höflich zuhört. Du passt deine Tonalität an, stellst die richtigen Fragen und baust Vertrauen auf.
...Struktur in Chaos verwandelt
Dein CRM ist deine Bibel. Follow-ups? Terminiert. Notes? Detailliert. Pipeline? Kristallklar. Du verlierst nie den Überblick.
...bereits die ersten Schlachten gewonnen hat
1-2 Jahre im B2B-Vertrieb, Sales Development oder Telemarketing? Perfekt. Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einem Lead und einer Opportunity. Du weißt, wie CRM-Systeme funktionieren. Idealerweise hast du schon mal in der SaaS- oder Tech-Welt gearbeitet.

Neben unserem großartigen Team, unserer Unternehmenskultur und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Menschen mit Daten zu empowern, gibt es viele weitere Gründe, warum Statista ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist! Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von folgenden Vorteilen:

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.
We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams
All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page.

We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond.

Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Job Description
Turnitin is seeking a disciplined, resourceful, and self-driven Sales Development Representative to drive sales growth by strategically prospecting into new accounts and identifying high-quality leads for the sales team.
As the first point of contact for new business prospects, you will be a crucial partner to our account executives. Your role is to develop a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities by conducting market research, executing data-driven campaigns, and developing dynamic territory plans.

You will understand the Turnitin Integrity and Assessment product portfolios to assess potential customers' needs, mitigate objections, and position the right solutions.

You will own the relationship until the prospect is qualified and ready to engage with a sales account executive, allowing them to focus on closing deals while you focus on generating new opportunities.

Strategic Planning & Prospecting: Conduct market research and analysis to inform go-to-market strategy. Collaborate with your regional sales team to develop and execute a dynamic territory plan, identifying key opportunities and ensuring all activities have measurable outcomes.
Lead Generation: Actively prospect into assigned territories to generate new leads. Develop and execute targeted multi-touch inbound and outbound campaigns via social media, email, and phone to drive engagement and build a robust pipeline.
Lead Qualification & Advancement: Follow up on, qualify, and nurture all assigned leads. Navigate institutional buying processes by mapping key decision-makers and influencers. Skillfully mitigate prospect objections by clarifying concerns and responding with well-prepared solutions.
Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with the sales team to determine the next steps for each prospect. Keep the sales team informed on project statuses, ensuring all relevant CRM systems (like Salesforce.com) are updated in real-time.
Performance & Development: Achieve or exceed all assigned Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Manage detailed prospect account lists, diligently tracking lead progress. Continuously learn and develop your technical, competitive, and sales skills.

Bachelor’s degree or at least 5 years of relevant work experience.
3+ years experience as a sales development representative with a track record of achieving lead/sales quotas.
Experience in a SaaS and/or Ed Tech environment is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience initiating and nurturing relationships with potential customers using targeted outbound prospecting techniques (social media, email, phone).
Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM is required.
Flawless communication skills (oral and written) and comfort presenting to prospects.
Proven ability to work autonomously and as a productive team member, demonstrating a strong work ethic and a proactive approach.
Experience using prospecting applications like LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Proven creative problem-solving approach and strong analytical skills.
Full proficiency in English

## Das erwartet dich ##
Bei der Mobiliar Generalagentur Wil legen wir Wert auf nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen und hohe Servicequalität. Im Verkaufssupport leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur zielgerichteten Unterstützung unseres Beraterteams und zur professionellen Betreuung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden.

Dafür suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberaterinnen und -berater im Tagesgeschäft unterstützt und aktiv zur verlässlichen Betreuung unserer Kundschaft beiträgt.

Mit deiner strukturierten Arbeitsweise und deinem Dienstleistungsverständnis stärkst du das Vertrauen in die Mobiliar als persönlichste Versicherung der Schweiz.
## Das bewirkst du bei uns ##
Du unterstützt unsere Versicherungsberaterinnen und -berater im operativen Alltag und übernimmst eigenverantwortlich administrative und koordinierende Aufgaben.
Dazu gehören die Erstellung von Korrespondenz, Auswertungen sowie die Bearbeitung von Offerten, Anträgen und Vertragsunterlagen. Im direkten Kundenkontakt am Telefon oder am Schalter betreust du unsere Kundschaft kompetent und verlässlich.
Du beantwortest Anfrage und koordinierst Termine über sämtliche Versicherungsbranchen hinweg. Als Teil des Verkaufssupportteams arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und stellst reibungslose Abläufe sicher.
## Das bringst du mit ##
* Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung und oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung innerhalb der Versicherungsbranche
* Ausbildung Versicherungsvermittler oder Versicherungsvermittlerin VBV oder Bereitschaft, diese zu absolvieren
* Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein
* Interesse an einem vielseitigen Tätigkeitsfeld und Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen
* Strukturierte, selbständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Teamorientierung, hohe Hilfsbereitschaft und professionelle Grundhaltung
## Bei uns arbeiten ##
Auf der Generalagentur Wil erwartet dich ein engagiertes und vielfältiges Team. Gemeinsam stärken wir unsere regionale Verankerung und schaffen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden konsistente 5 Sterne Erlebnisse. Wir pflegen einen offenen, respektvollen und kollegialen Austausch und arbeiten lösungsorientiert sowie verantwortungsbewusst zusammen. Dich erwarten klare Strukturen, kurze Entscheidungswege, eine sorgfältige Einführung sowie zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen bei der Mobiliar.
Dein Arbeitsort ist auf unserer Hauptagentur in Ebnat-Kappel und der Stellenantritt erfolgt nach Vereinbarung.
Das Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz verlangt zur Ausübung dieser Funktion den Abschluss Versicherungsvermittler/-in VBV, Profil Allbranche. Sollte dieser nicht vorhanden sein, unterstützen wir gerne mit massgeschneiderten internen Ausbildungen.
## Das bieten wir ##
##### Erfolgsbeteiligung #####
Sind wir erfolgreich, profitieren auch unsere Mitarbeitenden. Jedes Jahr wird über die Ausschüttung einer Erfolgsbeteiligung und deren Höhe entschieden.

Wir bieten ein vielfältiges internes Kursangebot an. Bei jobrelevanten Weiterbildungen beteiligen wir uns.

Wir bieten unter anderem bis zu 25% Prämienrabatt, Rabatte auf Mobiltelefone sowie kostenlose Abonnemente mit Flatrate und Ermässigungen bei kulturellen Veranstaltungen.

A willingness to work with others across the sales team and a desire to help build the future of the Ceros sales engine.
A "start-up soul" that thrives in a changing environment with an ever-evolving AI-forward product.

Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

s.h: What You Can Expect from MCI
s.t:
We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:
Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
Health Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for supplemental health coverage through Blue Cross.
Life Insurance: Access life insurance options to safeguard your loved ones.
Supplemental Insurance: Accident and critical illness insurance
Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.
Paid Training: Learn new skills while earning a paycheck.
Fun, Engaging Work Environment: Enjoy a team-oriented culture that fosters collaboration and engagement.
Casual Dress Code: Be comfortable while you work.

s.h: Compensation & Benefits that Fit Your Life
s.t:
MCI takes pride in tailoring our offerings to fit the needs of our diverse team across subsidiaries and locations. While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.
If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

Für unseren Standort Zürich suchen wir aktuell Verstärkung!
Was Dich erwartet
* **Was ist das eigentliche Problem?** – Dafür führen wir Organisationsanalysen ( FTE, Prozesse, Strukturen, Skills) und Benchmarking im HR\-Umfeld durch, entwickeln Lösungen anhand datengetriebener Evidenzen, setzen diese in den entsprechenden Kontext und formulieren klare Handlungsempfehlungen – von Data Analytics bis Due Diligence ist alles dabei. Ausserdem bieten wir zahlreiche Schnittstellen zu spannenden Projekten in den Bereichen Performance Management und Compensation
* **Wie finden wir Lösungen?** – Konzeption schreiben wir gross. Wir optimieren Operating Modelle ( Organisationsstrukturen, Prozesse, Rollen, etc.), Talent Management, Workforce Transformation, HR\-IT, M\&A Prozesse und Carve Outs ebenso wie Vergütungsstrukturen. Alles, was Menschen und Organisationen betrifft, nehmen wir in die Hand!
* **Wie machen wir das?** – In Projektarbeit! Wir agieren als Team und da muss jeder konzeptionelle und operative Aufgaben in Projekten übernehmen. Sei es die Erstellung der Vorstandsunterlagen zur Organisationstransformation, die Konzepterarbeitung einer HR\-Strategie oder zielgerichtetes Projektmanagement.
* **Wie bleiben wir innovativ?** – Indem wir Research betreiben, uns mit den relevanten und zukunftsträchtigen Themen beschäftigen, Studien und Konzeptpapiere erarbeiten sowie unsere Vorgehensweisen und Leistungen kontinuierlich optimieren.

Bedeutet, Du solltest neben einer guten Sprachökonomie die Expertise besitzen, Inhalte auf Slides zu bringen. Inhaltliche Diskussionen mit Kunden kannst Du eigenständig führen.

Hierfür ist es nötig, sich seiner Rolle bewusst zu sein, Resilienz in sich wechselnden Situationen zu haben und mit Feedback umgehen sowie Feedback geben zu können. Unsere junioren Kolleg:innen erwarten Orientierung von Dir.
